metadata.title: Mobile Privacy Boundaries

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enforcing privacy boundaries between institutional security controls and personal mobile device data.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile privacy controls, data minimization mechanisms, container separation, and telemetry scoping for mobile platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern defining explicit privacy boundaries and least‑visibility guarantees within Zero Trust mobile architectures.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.value: SP 800-53 Rev.5; SP 800-207; SP 800-124 Rev.2; NIST Privacy Framework
props.remarks: Mobile Privacy Boundaries align with NIST privacy engineering, data minimization, and Zero Trust guidance.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Privacy Boundaries defines the explicit limits on institutional visibility, control, and data collection for mobile devices. This pattern ensures privacy preservation is enforced as an architectural property rather than a policy afterthought.

components.title: Mobile Observation Minimization
components.description: Restricts institutional telemetry collection to only data strictly required for security and access decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: System information discovery beyond legitimate security needs.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security and privacy safeguards are defined and limited in scope.
Collection of information is limited to authorized purposes.

components.title: Managed and Personal Data Separation
components.description: Ensures institutional security controls apply only to managed application containers and do not extend into personal data spaces.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized access to personal data through over‑privileged management controls.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Container separation isolates institutional controls from personal data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow control prevents access to personal data spaces.
Personal data boundaries are explicitly respected.

components.title: Selective Control Limits
components.description: Restricts institutional control actions on mobile devices to explicitly authorized scopes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Security controls abused to exert excessive influence over endpoints.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strict enforcement boundaries prevent control overreach.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege applies to security administration actions.

components.title: Mobile User Transparency
components.description: Ensures mobile users are informed of institutional control boundaries and data visibility.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Covert enumeration of user data without awareness.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Control transparency reduces distrust and misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Transparency mechanisms inform users of data and control boundaries.
